description: Transforming financial statements into visually appealing Sankey diagrams has never been easier. Our advanced tool allows you to quickly convert complex financial data into stunning Sankey diagrams with just a few clicks. It can visualize especially negative values and calculates accordingly. Here’s how our Visual makes it effortless for you to present your financial statements: Quick Conversion: Seamlessly transform your financial statements into Sankey diagrams. Upload your data into Power BI according to our sample Data, and our Visual will automatically process and convert it into a beautiful, easy-to-understand flow diagram. Look at the sample Data to understand how the data has to be structured. Automatic Node Arrangement: Our smart algorithm arranges nodes for optimal readability and aesthetic appeal. You no longer have to worry about manually positioning each element; our tool does it for you, ensuring a clean and professional look every time. Customized Sorting: Tailor the sorting of nodes to fit your specific needs. Whether you want to highlight certain financial aspects or follow a particular sequence, our tool provides the flexibility to sort nodes as per your requirements. Look at the sample Data for help. Income Statements Showcasing: Perfectly showcase income statements with detailed breakdowns. Visualize revenue, expenses, and profits in a comprehensive flow…
